name: ListItem
purpose: One row: setting, device with a control, or read-only information.

elements.content: Title and subtitle column; shrinks and truncates.
elements.title: Primary text, single line with ellipsis.
elements.subtitle: Secondary text, single line with ellipsis.
elements.trailing: Value, control (toggle) or chevron; never shrinks.

behavior: One tap target per row: an interactive row is a single button; a row with a toggle is not tappable itself.
Read-only rows give no touch feedback.

lvgl.notes: Row flex container; interactive rows are clickable objects.
